text:
liz_docs: heads-up: found a small docs CI failure from the nightly run. looks like console/observability/examples/route-costs.md still uses the old `cost_per_token` metric in a couple of inline YAML snippets.

sam_engineering: thanks, can you paste the lines? i'll try a local reproduce.

liz_docs: sure — snippet under 'Per-route breakdown' block:
```
- metric: metrics.cost_per_token
  aggregate: sum
  label: total cost
```
should be `metrics.unit_cost` and aggregate maybe stay `sum`.

arun_infra: fwiw the rename was part of infra/schema#102, we kept an alias in the runtime for a month but it got dropped in the patch release last night.

toni_prod: oh that explains it. do we need to update any example dashboards or screenshots as well or just the YAML?

liz_docs: quick grep showed one image filename assets/route-costs-snapshot.png but the caption is generic. only the YAML needs editing.

sam_engineering: i'll open a micro-PR to update the snippets + add an inline comment noting the old key for searchability.

sam_engineering: PR opened: #3412 - updates two YAML snippets and adds a brief note in docs/CHANGELOG.md. running `make docs` locally now.

doc-bot: [ci/docs] build failed 1713510015 — reason: unknown metric 'metrics.cost_per_token' in console/observability/examples/route-costs.md

sam_engineering: saw that, pushed a follow-up commit to PR fixing the other snippet.

sam_engineering: also added a one-line unit test in scripts/docs_smoke.sh to grep for `metrics.cost_per_token` and fail if found, with a TODO to replace with a proper linter later.

liz_docs: could we instead have the smoke test check against a list file `docs/deprecated_keys.txt` so we can append other deprecated names over time?

arun_infra: that's better. i've opened infra#210 to add a shared list; but until that's merged, can we add the local list in docs/ to unblock the PR?

sam_engineering: done — added docs/deprecated_keys.txt and wire the smoke script to read it. PR updated.

doc-bot: [ci/docs] build passed 1713510199 :tada:

toni_prod: nice! can we add a short note in the migration guide about the rename and the reason so product teams are aware for any dashboards they export?

liz_docs: good idea. i'll add a 1-paragraph note in console/observability/migration.md referencing infra/schema#102 and linking the CHANGELOG entry.

sam_engineering: perfect. LGTM, merging now. thanks everyone :heart:

liz_docs: thanks all, and great catch by nightly run. will follow up to track adding more deprecated keys to the shared infra list.
